name: shahar-polaks-career-studio
description: AI career coaching for CVs, LinkedIn profiles and interviews, grounded in your real experience. Hebrew and English.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your real experience into stronger CVs, LinkedIn profiles, and interview answers. Career Studio helps you compare your background with a target role, identify matches and gaps, sharpen your wording, and prepare a clear personal pitch.

Start with what you have: a CV, a job description, profile text, an existing pitch, or a real interview story. Get practical improvements first, followed by focused questions where important evidence is missing. Work in Hebrew or English.

Build an ATS-friendly CV, improve your LinkedIn headline and About section, practice a role-focused introduction, or shape a STAR answer. Choose from the included Classic, Crimson, and Warm CV design references when supported export tools are available.

When Browser is connected and supported by your host, review requested profile, job, and company pages. Browser access and document export depend on your connection and available tools. Career Studio flags claims that need confirmation and keeps sample material separate from your experience.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my CV truthfully for this role.
Analyze my CV against this job posting.
Improve my LinkedIn profile for my target role.
